notes: UNVERIFIED: the cart and wishlist paths (/viewcart, /wishlist) and the saved-for-later location were written from general knowledge, not read off the live site. Confirm them against a logged-in session before the first real run, and correct this file if they differ. The guard fails closed, so a wrong path blocks the read rather than exposing anything.
Product pages are /<slug>/p/<itemId>; the slug is free-form so the allow regex matches any single path segment before /p/.
